why: In `@double/helper.m`, a method of MATLAB's own class `double` (no class `double` in the project), `x` is the method's own object, a double (MATLAB doc 'Methods in Separate Files'; a method of a built-in class runs for its values), so `tidy(x)` dispatches to `@double/tidy.m` before the root `tidy.m` (doc 'Function Precedence Order': object functions before the path).
